resources.name: work-injuries
resources.title: Workplace injuries and fatal work injuries by state and industry (BLS SOII and CFOI)
resources.description: How often workers are hurt on the job in each state and industry, and how many die: the nonfatal injury and illness rate per 100 full-time workers for private-industry sectors and detailed industries in the states BLS publishes (Survey of Occupational Injuries and Illnesses, 2024), and the number and rate of fatal work injuries in every state and DC, with the major cause and the industry rate (Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries, 2024). Every record carries its BLS series or table. Survey estimates carry a relative standard error and a noise flag; figures BLS does not publish are marked suppressed and never filled in. It is statistics about industries and states, never about a named employer.
